title: delta: attested atomic upgrade bundles + Helm immutability + TF index outputs
author: Ethan McDowell
description:
Problem: Private deployment upgrades sometimes left clusters in a mixed state when an install artifact bundle was partially published or a release pipeline retried mid-publish. This PR introduces an end-to-end flow for building 'delta' upgrade bundles that are produced atomically, signed/attested, and consumable by the private installer (VPC/on-prem). The change spans the release CI pipeline, Helm chart packaging, Terraform module outputs, and the upgrade/rollback indexer.

What this PR does (summary):
- Adds a delta manifest generator (scripts/release/generate-delta-manifest.sh) that takes a previous release index and a target set of artifacts and emits a single atomic bundle (tar.gz) plus a JSON attestations file (cosign + in-repo provenance metadata) so an operator can validate integrity before applying.
- Modifies Helm chart packaging to enforce immutability: charts are packaged with digested image pins in Chart.lock and the installer chart renderer will refuse charts without digests unless explicitly allowed by a 'allow_untagged_images' flag (default false).
- Exposes Terraform module outputs (terraform/modules/vpc/release_index_url.tf) so an operator can wire a release index URL into private deployment automation without touching the installer state.
- Adds a rollback indexer that generates minimal rollback manifests which reference exact digested artifacts and include cosign signatures to improve rollback safety.
- Updates CI: .github/workflows/release-builder.yaml now produces provenance bundles (SBOM-lite JSON), uploads delta bundles to the release bucket, signs them with cosign (KMS-backed keys), and emits a stable signed manifest that the private installer downloads.
- Documentation and runbook: docs/release/delta-bundles.md and docs/runbooks/upgrade-validate.md with step-by-step validation and example commands.

Why: These changes close a class of incidents where partially published artifacts or unpinned images created inconsistent cluster state during upgrades. Attestation + atomic bundle semantics simplify operator validation and allow safe automated rollbacks.

Checklist:
- [x] Generate delta bundle and attest with cosign in CI
- [x] Helm chart packaging includes image digest pinning (Chart.lock updated)
- [x] Terraform outputs for release index URL added and documented
- [x] Rollback indexer implemented and tested against e2e cluster fixture
- [x] Docs and runbook added; internal validation steps documented
- [x] Secrets and credentials masking added to CI logs per security review

review_comments: Priya: please don't print full GCR credential blob in the release logs - mask with project-only info (fixed in CI mask script)
Jordi: can rollback indexer guarantee eventual rollback success if an artifact is GC'd? Answer: indexer references digests only and we now pin retention policy; added retention note to docs
Liam: suggest making allow_untagged_images explicit in values.yaml - added schema and default false
review_outcome: approved with minor fixes; security reviewed by Priya Sinha and +1 from Jordi; merged after CI green and changelog updated.
ci_summary: Initial pipeline run failed lint (shellcheck) and an integration test flake; fixed scripts and test timeout, rerun completed: all checks passed (unit, shellcheck, e2e-upgrade, cosign-sign). Artifacts uploaded to gs://redwood-private-releases/delta/2026-02-18/ and signed manifest available at release-index/v1.9/delta-2026-02-18.json.
release_notes: Adds atomic delta upgrade bundles for private installer: signed attestations, Helm chart immutability enforcement, Terraform release index wiring, and a safer rollback indexer. Operators should use the new release-index URL and validate cosign attestations before applying upgrades.
testing: Manual end-to-end tested against k8s fixture (kind w/ mock registry) and integration tests added to test/e2e/upgrade-delta.test.js. CI runs include cosign signature verification step and an e2e upgrade+rollback smoke test.
deployment_instructions: Release CI publishes delta bundle + signed manifest. For private deployments: download delta bundle, verify cosign attestations with 'cosign verify-blob' against the KMS-backed public key, then run 'installer apply --bundle <path>' which will validate digests and apply atomically. See docs/release/delta-bundles.md for examples.
notes: This PR intentionally keeps the legacy non-delta release path for a transition period. 'allow_untagged_images' must be set to true on older clusters during migration. We coordinated retention policy changes with infra to avoid digest GC during the rollout window.
security_considerations: CI now signs artifacts with cosign using KMS-backed keys and stores signature blobs next to bundles. Credentials are masked in logs; key access is restricted to release pipeline service accounts. Added note to docs about verifying public key fingerprints out-of-band.
notes_for_release_manager: When cutting v1.9.1-private, enable retention policy change in the registry and coordinate with infra to ensure the release-index URL is populated in the terraform module outputs. The release runbook includes a quick checklist for rollback validation.
